entities.name: Protestant Marriage Reform
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Martin Luther rejected marriage as a sacrament — calling it a "worldly thing" governed by civil law. He married a former nun (Katharina von Bora) in 1525, shocking Catholic Europe. Protestant churches allowed clergy to marry and permitted divorce for adultery or desertion.
